assignments.title: Categories aur Products schema
assignments.brief: Do related tables ki migrations banao.
tasks: `create_products_table` banao (category_id foreign key, name, price, stock, is_active)
`migrate:fresh` chalao aur `db:table products` se check karo
assignments.explain: Parent table (`categories`) ki migration pehle chalni chahiye.

assignments.title: Seed aur query
assignments.brief: Fake data bharo aur query builder se padho.
tasks: Tinker mein 500 se mehnge products price descending nikalo
assignments.explain: `Product::factory()->count(20)->create()` rows banata hai, query builder unhe padhta hai.

interview.a: Database schema ka version control: table aur column badlaav PHP code mein, jo team ke saath share hota hai.
`fresh` saari tables drop karke migrate karta hai. `refresh` rollback karke dobara migrate karta hai.
Ek table ka column jo doosri table ke primary key ko point karta hai aur data integrity rakhta hai.
Many-to-many relation ke liye beech ki table jisme dono tables ke ids hote hain.

interview.q: What is the difference between a seeder and a factory?
interview.a: Seeder data bharta hai, factory fake data ka blueprint hai.

interview.q: How does the query builder prevent SQL injection?
interview.a: PDO parameter binding se: values SQL string mein nahi, alag bheji jaati hain.
